text:
Maya Patel: Quick ask — want to lock a 60m design review for the new streaming-multiplex API + SDK hooks + Console UX on next-week schedule. Goal: API contract signoff, SDK usage pattern, and two console mockwalks (admin + developer).
Dan Lewis: +1. can do Tue/Wed mornings. prefer not after 4pm PST.
Priya Shah: I can take the API contract review and split out security/authorization concerns. Tue 11am PST works for me.
Mateo Ruiz: Will take SDK review. need to validate batching semantics and error surface.
Raj Varma: UX can prep two quick mockups — one compact table, one flow with inline inspector. I have availability Wed 10-11 or Thu 9-10.
Maya Patel: Proposed slots: Mon 11am-12pm PST, Tue 11am-12pm PST, Wed 10am-11am PST. Reply with first choice.
Priya Shah: Tue 11am.
Dan Lewis: Wed 10am (if Raj can make Wed). otherwise Tue 11am ok.
Mateo Ruiz: Tue 11am.
Raj Varma: Wed 10am still best for me. if we need demo infra I'll ask infra to reserve a test pool.
Maya Patel: OK looks like Wed 10am wins but keep Tue as backup. Action items before session:
- API: add example request/response for multiplexed streams and auth header examples
- SDK: add small snippet showing how to subscribe/unsubscribe and backpressure behavior
- Console: two mocks + where the new toggle/permission lives
- E2E demo: simple replay script (optional)

Maya Patel: Pre-read link: https://docs.internal/redwood/streams/multiplex-pre-read (please skim the "breaking changes" and "migration path" sections)

Priya Shah: Quick checklist I'm asking reviewers to confirm by EOD Mon (paste below):
```
- [ ] API surface aligned with existing streaming endpoints
- [ ] auth model documented (scopes, tokens)
- [ ] error codes mapped to SDK exceptions
- [ ] migration notes for existing clients
```

Mateo Ruiz: SDK note — this is a tiny surface change, but it changes ordering guarantees. I'll add the RFC section "ordering-and-duplicates" to the pre-read.

Dan Lewis: Calendar-bot: can you create the event for Wed 2060007923 (that's Wed 10am PST) and link the pre-read + attach mocks? I'll nominate @Priya Shah and @Mateo Ruiz as primary reviewers, @Dan Lewis as backup.
calendar-bot: created event "Streaming Multiplex — design review" for Wed 10:00–11:00 PST, guests: Maya Patel, Priya Shah, Mateo Ruiz, Dan Lewis, Raj Varma. RSVP in the event.

Raj Varma: UX ask — please upload screenshots to the event or drop here. I'll add annotated hot spots.
Maya Patel: I'll upload a short demo dataset and a small replay script gist before EOD Tue.
Priya Shah: I'll cross-check auth flows with security and post any blocker notes.
Mateo Ruiz: Also adding a tiny code snippet for SDK docs in the pre-read:
```
const sub = client.streamMultiplex({ topics: ["a","b"] });
sub.on('message', (m) => handle(m));
sub.close();
```

Dan Lewis: If anyone can't make the live slot, post review comments on the doc and I'll triage. we should finalize API shape in the meeting and then cut a canary branch.
Maya Patel: Thanks all — will confirm Wed 10am in the event once mocks + pre-read are up. :thumbsup:
